title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Jersey
desc: Arjun, a gifted yet failed cricketer, makes a daring comeback in his late thirties, driven by his dream of playing for India and fulfilling his son's wish for a jersey.

title: Jawan
desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

title: Akhanda 2: Thaandavam
desc: As biological warfare threatens the country, a scientist seeks a cure. But when dangerous forces target her, a warrior returns to defend humanity.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl, who is speech impaired, lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she belongs to Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Bholaa
desc: An ex-convict, released after ten years, struggles to reunite with his daughter. His journey is filled with obstacles, testing his determination, love, and hope for redemption.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Dabangg 2
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, kills a corrupt politician's brother, sparking revenge. When his wife is attacked, an enraged Chulbul takes on his enemies to protect his family.
